references.text: Parallel account of Israel's arrival at Mount Hor on the border of Edom, where Aaron was to die.
Describes Israel's stay in Kadesh, the starting point for the journey mentioned in this verse.
The context for why Israel had to travel along the border of Edom—Edom refused them passage.
Reference to Mount Hor as the place where Aaron died.
Continuation describing Aaron's death on Mount Hor.
Kadesh is mentioned as a boundary marker for the promised land.
